name: High Accuracy Volume Rendering for Unstructured Data
aliases: Exact Volume Rendering for Unstructured Data
High Accuracy Volume Renderer for Unstructured Data
definition: A volume rendering system for unstructured data (especially finite element data) that creates images with very high accuracy without compromises or approximations for the sake of efficiency.
summary: High Accuracy Volume Rendering for Unstructured Data is a batch-mode renderer that guarantees mathematical exactness for tetrahedral meshes, distinguishing itself by avoiding the approximations used for efficiency in other systems.
